dataset_name: Ovarian Ultrasound Dataset (Saadat et al. / Borna et al. 2025)
reference_paper: Borna et al., Frontiers in Physiology 2025, doi:10.3389/fphys.2025.1520898
scientific_disclaimer: These ultrasound categories (Normal, Dominant Follicle, PCO) reflect ovarian morphological findings, which are NOT equivalent to a full clinical diagnosis of PCOS (which requires Rotterdam criteria including hyperandrogenism and ovulatory dysfunction). The small number of Normal images (N=41) poses an imbalance constraint.
